name: laravel-house
description: House skills for Laravel projects: project setup, Docker hosting behind Caddy, and the kanban board.

plugins.name: laravel-house
plugins.description: Start a Laravel project on the house rules (Blade + htmx with optional Svelte islands, a SvelteKit SSR app, or API-only; optional Reverb and multi-tenancy), run it in Docker behind Caddy, and drive its work from the house kanban board.
